audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven chart rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Mirror and packet both read Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Sylas, Sylas. My side read Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas — the two pages would answer 'who wins level 2' differently.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group, with the whys on the changed rows rewritten to justify their new owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row was written as Sylas taking over and the first-item why still opened with 'Hijack online'.
audit.why: Explosive Cask is 100/85/70 and Gragas keeps Drunken Rage's damage reduction plus the Happy Hour heal, so 6 is not the flip; Riftmaker is.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as still his, the item spike restated as yours, with the 100s and 14s numbers written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam had no cooldown attached anywhere, and Drunken Rage was described only as damage reduction.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — a flat 14s at rank 1 and barely shorter at rank 5, which is why absorbing it wins the counter-trade. Drunken Rage is a 5s auto-attack reset (the flagged missing 'autoreset-burst-tell'): the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and wants.foe[1].

audit.why: The 'needs-antiheal' interaction is already served by report[8] ('Add anti-heal early into his sustain'), which is the answer to Happy Hour.

edits.before: W online — the burst-heal turns even trades into wins. Take the extended trade only when his answer is down.
edits.after: W online, but so is Body Slam at 14s — poke with Q and make him spend the charge before you step in.

edits.before: Body Slam is now live and his damage-reduction W is online — he skirmishes better than you right now; don't feed him a free E2 dive.

edits.before: His damage-reduction W and Q slow let him dictate spacing through your pre-6 window — farm, chip with Q, and hold E1 for survival.
edits.after: At 6 his Explosive Cask (100s) plus the 5-second W reduction and Happy Hour heal still edge the 1v1 — steal it, but fight with your jungler.

edits.before: Hijack online: you now own his Explosive Cask, his Body Slam is on cooldown after the engage, and your Riftmaker W-heal out-sustains his remaining tools — all-in immediately.
edits.after: Riftmaker online: your W heal out-sustains Happy Hour, and with Explosive Cask stolen he engages on a 14-second Body Slam and nothing else — all-in the moment it is spent.

edits.before: His engage and his escape in one button — punish the cooldown hard. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1 — his engage and his escape in one button. Absorb it, then commit while it cools.

edits.before: Gragas spends Body Slam early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Gragas spends Body Slam early — 14 seconds where he cannot reach you or leave.

edits.before: That is Gragas’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Body Slam into W reduction beats any trade you start.

edits.before: Track Gragas’s Body Slam: His engage and his escape in one button — punish the cooldown hard. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Body Slam (E): 14s at rank 1, his engage and escape in one button. Drunken Rage is a 5s auto reset — the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — His engage and his escape in one button — punish the cooldown hard. Check it before every step-up. - E1 shield is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — 14s at rank 1, his engage and his escape in one button; punish the downtime. - Drunken Rage is a 5s auto reset — step back on the wind-up, not the cast. - Explosive Cask is 100s at rank 1.

edits.after: Pop Drunken Rage (W) for the damage reduction and empowered auto reset, turning the HP exchange against your heal
